newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates fluctuate on operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates fluctuate on operation.

text.p: The Pakistan money market rates fluctuated widely on Wednesday amid a weekly open market operation by the State Bank of Pakistan, dealers said.

Major trades were struck between 14 and 16 percent and the rates closed at 12 percent after the results of the operation, in which the bank picked up some five billion rupees at an annualised cut-off yield of 17 percent, were announced, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
The market closed short and some one billion rupees were reported to have been discounted, he added.
